package application

import (
	"context"

	. "metaldocs/internal/platform/authn"
)

// A3.3 negative fixture (Rule 3, dot import of the CANONICAL package): the same
// escape applied to the other protected path.
//
// Both paths need the ban, and for different reasons. Dot-importing
// iam/domain hides the forbidden accessor from Rule 1; dot-importing
// platform/authn hides the discard from Rule 2, because `actorID, _ :=
// UserIDFromContext(ctx)` below is exactly the fail-open binding Rule 2 exists
// to report and there is no qualifier left for it to resolve.
//
// Pinning them separately is the point: an implementation that banned only the
// low-level package would leave the canonical one dot-importable, and the
// underscore would be back.
//
// See scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/README.md.
func settleDotted(ctx context.Context) string {
	actorID, _ := UserIDFromContext(ctx)
	return actorID
}
